sensitivity_bound_arm.sensitivity_floor_definition: Smallest SNR such that all three PSF-ratio injections recover at that SNR and at every higher preregistered SNR; if none, report GREATER_THAN_20.
sensitivity_bound_arm.interpretation: A sensitivity bound only. It does not convert an epoch that failed T2C into QUALIFIED_ABSENCE.

product_provenance_arm.query: IRSA IBE ZTF science metadata at the frozen sky coordinate with no COLUMNS restriction, followed by exact matching on frozen filefracday/field/ccdid/qid/filtercode and pid when present.
product_provenance_arm.goal: Distinguish a path-construction problem from a metadata record whose exact science product is unavailable.

success_semantics.PASS_FORENSIC_CHARACTERIZATION_COMPLETE: All six sensitivity curves and all three exact product-provenance audits produce receipts.
success_semantics.BLOCKED_FORENSIC_CHARACTERIZATION_INCOMP: Any targeted sensitivity curve or exact product-provenance audit cannot be completed.

next_decision_after_t2d: Freeze the ZTF branch with explicit sensitivity/product limitations, then evaluate an independent TESS cadence-native prepointed replication unless T2D exposes a correctable provenance bug that can be repaired without changing product identity.
